zh.title: 失踪者是你
zh.text:
你在一间值班室里醒来。外套滴着水，鞋底却是干的。桌上的失踪案卷标着明天的日期，照片里的人是你。
守夜人把一副牌摆好。他已经填完了你的姓名，只等你确认。

en.title: You Are the Missing Person
en.text:
You wake in a duty room. Your coat is dripping. The soles of your shoes are dry. A missing-person file on the desk is dated tomorrow. It contains your photograph.
The Night Watch has laid out a deck of cards. Your name is already on the form. He is waiting for you to confirm it.

zh.subtitle: 记录仍在继续
zh.caption: 这份案卷里，只有你的失踪尚未发生。
zh.text: 你在陌生小镇醒来，案卷上的失踪者却是自己。六处现场，九十六份口供。有人守着出口，有人记得你没有经历过的事。把愿意同行的人带上；接近最后一扇门时，录音里的你，已经问过相同的问题。
zh.loop: 第{loop}次调查 · 证词仍在

en.subtitle: The record is still running.
en.caption: Your disappearance is the only event still to happen.
en.text: You wake in an unfamiliar town. The missing person in the file is you. Six sites. Ninety-six statements. Someone is guarding the exit. Others remember things you have not done. Take the witnesses willing to come with you. Near the last door, a recording of your voice is already asking the same questions.

zh.title: 停电发生在03:17
zh.text: 镇上的人都把停电时间说成03:17，却没有两个人记得同一天。街口的告示贴着你的照片，纸已经被雨泡旧。守夜人说，想离开，就先把十六份证词核完。

en.title: The Power Failed at 03:17
en.text: Everyone gives 03:17 as the time of the outage. No two people agree on the day. Your photograph is posted at the corner, on paper already spoiled by rain. The Night Watch says you can leave when sixteen statements have been checked.

zh.title: 寄件人一栏
zh.text: 最后一份证词夹着一个空信封，寄件人是你，邮戳的日期还没到。你选中的同行者收好信封，说钟楼的人能读懂邮戳。门开着，他却等你先走。

en.title: The Sender Field
en.text: An empty envelope is clipped to the last statement. You sent it. The postmark is dated in the future. The companion you chose pockets it and says someone at the bell tower can read the mark. The door is open. They wait for you to go first.

zh.title: 录音比你早一句
zh.text: 钟楼没有钟，值班表却按钟声换班。每过一层，都有人要求重录你的证词。磁带里，你总比自己早说一句；有一处停顿里，多了一次呼吸。

en.title: The Tape Is One Sentence Ahead
en.text: There is no bell in the tower. The duty roster still changes at the chime. On every floor, someone wants your statement recorded again. On the tape, your voice speaks one sentence before you do. An extra breath occupies one of the pauses.

zh.title: 没有上楼的人
zh.text: 你关掉录音机，带轮还在转。录音里的同行者说，楼上的人已经下来了。楼梯间没有脚步，门缝下却多了一张灰厂的交接单，签收人仍是你。

en.title: Nobody Went Upstairs
en.text: You switch off the recorder. The reels keep turning. On the tape, your companion says the person upstairs has come down. The stairwell is silent. An Ash Works transfer slip lies under the door, with your signature in the receipt field.

zh.title: 停产后的夜班
zh.text: 灰厂停产二十七年，夜班名单仍每天换新。防火女穿着沾灰的雨衣，守着冷炉，挨个收走工人手里的火柴。她脚边的封盒里，有一场尚未点燃的火。你在墙上找到自己的考勤记录，只有离岗次数。

en.title: The Shift After Closure
en.text: The works closed twenty-seven years ago. A new night-shift list appears every day. In an ash-stained raincoat, the Fire Warden collects matches beside a cold furnace. A sealed box at her feet contains a fire that has not started. Your attendance record lists only departures.

zh.title: 多出来的影子
zh.text: 停机后的复印机吐出一张码头照片。照片里的人都背对镜头，只有一个影子朝向你。同行者认出了自己的外套，却不肯承认照片里的那条路通往沉港。

en.title: The Extra Shadow
en.text: The disconnected copier produces a photograph of a quay. Everyone in it faces away from the camera. One shadow faces you. Your companion recognizes their coat but denies that the road in the photograph leads to Sunken Harbor.

zh.title: 没有海的港口
zh.text: 地图上，沉港离海还有很远。黑水里却映着一组陌生的星位。灯塔守护者把光打进水底；水下的回光，总比灯塔先亮一步。摆渡人只问，上次靠岸时，你身边有几个人。

en.title: A Harbor Far From the Sea
en.text: The map places Sunken Harbor far inland. Unfamiliar stars are reflected in its black water. The Lighthouse Warden directs the beam beneath the quay. The answering light always appears first. The ferryman asks how many people were with you the last time you came ashore.

zh.title: 同一张脸，三个名字
zh.text: 港务簿记着一艘从未建造的船，失踪乘客的照片与你相同。同行者各自认出了那张脸，说出的名字却不一样。你没有纠正他们；雪站的电报已经第三次催你到场。

en.title: One Face, Three Names
en.text: The harbor ledger lists a ship that was never built. Its missing passenger has your face. Your companions recognize the photograph. They give different names. You correct none of them. Snow Station has sent its third telegram asking you to attend.

zh.title: 接收位置上的求救声
zh.text: 雪把铁轨埋了，站内仍在广播一班没有终点的列车。值班员反复播放你的求救录音，电台却始终停在接收位置。你听见了白室的地址，那一段还没有被录到磁带上。

en.title: A Call on the Receive Channel
en.text: Snow covers the tracks. The station keeps announcing a train with no destination. The attendant plays your distress call. The radio is set to receive. You hear an address for the White Room. That section has not reached the tape yet.

zh.title: 下一页的口供
zh.text: 你终于找到求救者的签名，笔迹与你相同。下一页写着你刚刚打完的牌局，落款时间是03:17。同行者按住纸角，问你能不能先别翻到最后一页。

en.title: The Statement on the Next Page
en.text: You find the caller’s signature. It is in your handwriting. The next page describes the match you have just finished. The time is 03:17. A companion holds down the corner and asks you not to turn to the last page yet.

zh.title: 记录人也是你
zh.text: 白室里没有窗，墙上的潮痕却随海面升降。桌上只有你的案卷：失踪者、目击者、记录人，三栏填着同一个名字。门后有人请你核对最后一份证词；那是你尚未说出口的话。

en.title: You Took the Statement
en.text: There are no windows in the White Room. Damp marks on the walls rise and fall with a distant sea. Your file is on the table. Missing person, witness, recording officer: the same name in all three fields. Someone behind the door asks you to verify a statement you have not given yet.

zh.title: 案卷重新打开
zh.text:
最后一局结束，白墙上出现一道门。你推开它，回到雾镇的值班室。
钟指着03:17。桌上那份失踪案卷，日期仍是明天。
守夜人问你姓名。这一次，身后有人替你回答。同行者保留了各自的证词，没有两份对得上。你的旧签名下面，另一种笔迹正在起头。

en.title: The File Reopens
en.text:
The last match ends. A door appears in the white wall. You open it and step into the Fogtown duty room.
The clock reads 03:17. Tomorrow’s missing-person file is waiting on the desk.
The Night Watch asks your name. This time someone behind you answers. Your companions have kept their statements. None agrees with the others. Beneath your old signature, a second hand has begun to write.

zh.rewardText: 选择守关者的卡牌，接受对方作为同行证人。他们记得你没有经历过的事，也许知道出口在哪里。
zh.recruit: {boss}在证词上留下记号，站到你这一边。纸张背面多了一行：禁止单独行动。
zh.recruitGold: {boss}交出一份金边案卷。同一句证词下面，压着两种笔迹。
zh.recruitAgain: {boss}看了你很久。“这回先听我把录音放完。”
zh.cardNote: 同行证人。曾在对面的座位上，提供过另一份证词。
zh.ordinaryReward: 新的记录被放进案卷。选一张，带去下一处现场。
zh.selectionHint: 选择Boss牌，可让这位对手成为同行证人；卡牌技能与组卡规则不变。

en.rewardText: Choose a keeper’s card to take them with you as a witness. They remember things you have not done. They may know where the exit is.
en.recruit: {boss} marks the statement and comes to your side. A line has appeared on the back: no one proceeds alone.
en.recruitGold: {boss} hands you a file with a gold border. Two different hands have signed beneath the same statement.
en.recruitAgain: {boss} studies you. “This time, let the tape finish before you go.”
en.cardNote: A witness traveling with you. Their earlier statement was taken from the opposite chair.
en.ordinaryReward: Another record is placed in the file. Choose one for the next site.
en.selectionHint: Choose a Boss card to take a former opponent with you as a witness. Card abilities and deck rules stay the same.

zh.notice: 案卷重新打开。已获得的同行者、卡牌、收藏、保存牌组与重战解锁仍然保留。
zh.returnText: 雾镇的值班室没有变，桌上却多出几把椅子。你认得守夜人，也认得他准备问的问题。你把证词放在桌上，第一次没有照着录音回答。

en.notice: The file reopens. Your witnesses, cards, collection, saved deck and replay unlocks remain.
en.returnText: The Fogtown duty room is unchanged. There are more chairs at the table. You know the Night Watch and the question he is about to ask. You put the statements down. For once, you do not give the answer on the tape.
